title: Solution to the reflection equation related to the $\iota$quantum group of type AII
abstract: A solution to the reflection equation associated to a coideal subalgebra of $U_q(A_{2n-1}^{(1)})$ of type AII in the symmetric tensor representations is presented. If parameters of the coideal subalgebra are suitably chosen, the $K$ matrix does not depend on the quantum parameter $q$ and still agrees with a solution in arXiv:nlin/0411044 at $q=0$.

cards.snippet: ${\bf U}^\iota_\vep$ is a right coideal subalgebra of $\U$. Namely, we have $\Delta(\U^\iota_\vep)\subset \U^\iota_\vep\ot\U$.
